title: oxydectes angolensis
intro: Oxydectes angolensis, commonly known as the Angola or Red milkwood tree, is a plant species native to southern Africa. It is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid in the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Oxydectes angolensis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids and alkaloids, which are believed to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
